name: How much does an exterior kitchen remodel typically cost in Los Angeles?

mainEntity.name: How much does an exterior kitchen remodel typically cost in Los Angeles?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of an exterior kitchen remodel in Los Angeles varies significantly based on size, materials, appliances, and complexity. Basic setups with a grill and counter can start around $10,000-$20,000. Mid-range kitchens with more features, quality finishes, and additional appliances might range from $30,000-$70,000. Luxury, fully equipped outdoor kitchens with high-end materials, custom features, and extensive landscaping integration can exceed $100,000. Permits and site preparation are also factors.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary widely in Los Angeles, from $10,000 for basic setups to over $100,000 for luxury, fully equipped outdoor kitchens.
